## Known Limitations

### L1: Slice chain validation

**Status:** ✅ Resolved
**Symptom:** Mixed-depth joins (2D+1D+0D) now fully supported in to_pandas()
**Bug report:** `BUG_RDataFrameDSL_20260116_dsl_slice_chain.md`
**Resolution:** Phase 13.6.D - Mixed-depth join invariance tests added (15/15 pass)

### L2: Reductions on sliced 2D columns

**Status:** ✅ Resolved
**Symptom:** Sum/Mean/sqrt on sliced 2D columns previously caused ROOT JIT crash.
**Resolution:** Phase 13.6.D - Added explicit nested loop generation in backend_cpp.py
